map.已知波速与频率，求声波波长。: Given wave speed and frequency, find the sound wavelength.
map.343 m/s、440 Hz 对应波长约 0.78 m（A4 音）。: 343 m/s and 440 Hz correspond to a wavelength of about 0.78 m (note A4).
map.📚 深度解析：波长与频率关系: 📚 Deep Dive: The relation between wavelength and frequency
map.空气中波长 λ=c/f，由频率求空间周期。: In air lambda=c/f, giving the spatial period from the frequency.
map.扬声器分频、吸声材料厚度设计依据波长。: Loudspeaker crossover and absorber thickness design depend on wavelength.
map.理解低频波长长、高频波长短。: Understand that low frequencies have long wavelengths and high frequencies short ones.
map.c=343 m/s、f=1000 Hz，λ=343/1000=0.343 m，即: With c=343 m/s and f=1000 Hz, lambda=343/1000=0.343 m, about 34 cm.
map.为什么低频难被吸收？: Why are low frequencies hard to absorb?
map.低频波长很长（如 50 Hz 约 6.9 m），常规吸声材料厚度远小于波长，吸收: Low frequencies have very long wavelengths (e.g. 50 Hz is about 6.9 m) and conventional absorbers are far thinner than the wavelength, so absorption is inefficient.
map.波长与频率成反比吗？: Is wavelength inversely proportional to frequency?
map.在固定介质中是的：λ=c/f，频率翻倍波长减半。: Yes in a fixed medium: lambda=c/f, so doubling the frequency halves the wavelength.
map.波长 λ = 波速 v ÷ 频率 f（v 单位 m/s，f 单位 Hz）。校验：: Wavelength λ = wave speed v ÷ frequency f (v in m/s, f in Hz). Validation: frequency f (the denominator) must not be 0. Criteria: for sound or electromagnetic waves in a medium, λ is inversely proportional to f; given any two of the three you can find the third.
